description: Builds redirects.json (301s from old Bubble® paths and query forms to the new routes), a redirects.ts module, an _redirects file, legacy-urls.json and legacy-redirects.ts (saved into legacy_parity for compilation), and a curl script that tests every URL. Old URLs come from sitemap_url, url_list, gsc_urls, or wayback: true; compiled route patterns (path_patterns) and legacy slug matching run automatically on url_list as well as gsc_urls. A URL whose route or query filter still answers 200 is listed as unchanged; a URL it cannot place is listed as unmapped with the reason, never guessed. Give new routes with page_routes, for example { "listing_detail": "/rooms/:slug" }. Paid: needs a pass for the app, or the free trial for plans up to 1,000 records.

app_spec.description: app-spec.json, for the page list. Default: the one given to nc_audit.

cf_api_token.description: A Cloudflare API token with D1 edit permission on that account. Sealed in the job, deleted when it ends. Prefer nc_connect with job_id: the owner types tokens on a secure page. Only pass it here if nc_connect is not available.

go_ahead.description: Set true only when a charge applies, once the owner has seen the estimate and agreed to it. Not needed under the free trial or a pass that already covers the app. Needed again after a pass has expired.

gsc_urls.description: Search Console top pages URL list (old indexed URLs).

id_slug_map.description: { type: { bubble id: slug } }. Default: read from the loaded slug columns.

job_secret.description: The job_secret returned when this job was made (or the job's signed editor link). Required with job_id when no API key is sent: the job_id alone does not open a job.

new_base.description: Origin of the new app for the expected Location, for example https://www.example.com. Default: the old URL's own origin.

page_routes.description: Old page key to its new route. A route with :slug or :id takes one thing, for example /rooms/:slug.

page_types.description: Old page key to the data type it shows, when the name does not say.

path_patterns.description: Multi-segment path to query param mapping by route, for example { "/directory": ["trade", "loc"] }.

r2_access_key_id.description: Access key id of an R2 API token that can read and write that bucket. Prefer nc_connect with job_id: the owner types tokens on a secure page. Only pass it here if nc_connect is not available.

r2_bucket.description: An R2 bucket in that account, for staging and schema files.

r2_secret_access_key.description: Its secret. Sealed in the job, deleted when it ends. Prefer nc_connect with job_id: the owner types tokens on a secure page. Only pass it here if nc_connect is not available.

sitemap_url.description: The old app's sitemap.xml (a sitemap index is followed).

upgrade.description: Set true to pay the difference to the next pass that fits, only when the app is past its pass's (or free trial's) record or file limit.

wayback.description: Query Wayback CDX for historical 200 URLs on the app's domain.

name: nc_redirects
title: Build the old-to-new redirect map (paid)
